observation.command:
cd /workspace/.minio-build
cat > Dockerfile.minio <<'EOF'
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN groupadd -g 1000 minio-user && useradd -u 1000 -g minio-user -m -d /home/minio-user minio-user
RUN mkdir -p /data && chown -R 1000:1000 /data
COPY minio /usr/bin/minio
EXPOSE 9000 9001
USER 1000:1000
ENTRYPOINT ["minio"]
CMD ["server", "/data", "--address", ":9000", "--console-address", ":9001"]
EOF
cat > Dockerfile.mc <<'EOF'
FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY mc /usr/bin/mc
ENTRYPOINT ["mc"]
CMD ["--version"]
EOF
echo "=== pulling debian base ==="; docker pull debian:bookworm-slim 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "=== building minio/minio ==="; docker build -f Dockerfile.minio -t minio/minio:latest . 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== building minio/mc ==="; docker build -f Dockerfile.mc -t minio/mc:latest . 2>&1 | tail -3
docker images | grep -E "minio|debian"
